verdict.rationale: Loops documents audience segments that are dynamic and stay current as contact properties change, and campaigns can target them. That covers the attribute-based, live-updating core of the story. However, nothing shows segments built from tags or behavioral events, and the segment builder itself is undocumented beyond a heading. Missing for 10: evidence of tag-based segment criteria, evidence of event/behavior-based segment criteria, detailed segment-builder documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: Segments are dynamic and stay current as properties change.
